attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"In 2018, when Iranian-backed militias attacked the U.S. consulate in Basra, Iraq, the then-U.S. administration responded by closing the U.S. diplomatic facility.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In June 2019, when Iran shot down a U.S. surveillance aircraft operating in international airspace above the Straits of Hormuz, the then-U.S. administration responded by tweet and then called off any actual retaliation.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In September 2019, when Iranian-backed groups threatened global energy markets by attacking Saudi oil infrastructure, the then-U.S. administration failed to respond against Iran or its proxies.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In January 2020, when Iran directly launched ballistic missiles against U.S. troops in western Iraq, the then-U.S. administration mocked the resulting Traumatic Brain Injuries suffered by American servicemembers as mere \"headaches\" and took no action.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The then-U.S. administration's response to Iranian aggression during its presidency was characterized as feckless and weak.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
